stories.title: A hotter-than-expected September inflation report sends tech stocks tumbling
stories.reason: Headline CPI rose 3.7% year-over-year against a 3.6% forecast, pushing the Nasdaq down roughly 2% and lifting the two-year Treasury yield over 10 basis points as traders raised bets on another Federal Reserve rate hike at the October 27-28 meeting.

stories.title: A New York Times investigation finds Israel has leveled 48 of the roughly 60 villages it occupies in southern Lebanon
stories.reason: The destruction of homes, schools, mosques and roads has concentrated in Shia-majority villages since the April ceasefire with Hezbollah, with the UN saying 329,000 people have been displaced and Israel's own defense minister previously acknowledging the demolitions as punishment.

stories.title: US Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns at the White House's request amid a credit-card scandal
stories.reason: The resignation follows a Wall Street Journal report that she asked a Trump donor to pay off a $100,000 credit card bill in exchange for access to administration officials, along with allegations of improper gifts and threats to a host-country official, all of which she denies.

stories.title: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says a cargo ship sank after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz
stories.reason: It is the first reported sinking from a mine strike since the war began, and comes as at least 10 vessels have been attacked in or near the strait since Sunday, the highest rate of the conflict, with the ship reportedly on a route the US had urged ships to use.

stories.title: Federal investigators subpoena relatives of Rep. Ilhan Omar, including her sister
stories.reason: The grand jury subpoenas, issued two days after agents searched Omar's DC home, reportedly focus on whether her late father made false statements on immigration forms, as a US attorney has separately confirmed investigations into her net worth and immigration history.

stories.title: A Saudi national working as an OpenAI engineer is arrested for allegedly planting hidden recording devices in company offices
stories.reason: FBI investigators say Abdulrahman Alfozan hid a microphone-equipped device behind a TV in a San Francisco executive conference room and later concealed a second one, with OpenAI saying its own AI models helped identify him and that no model weights or customer data were accessed.

stories.title: Alibaba launches its Qwen Glasses N1 smart glasses, pushing AI onto wearables to rival Meta
stories.reason: Priced at $450 with a Pro model adding eye tracking and iris payments, the glasses mirror Meta's Ray-Ban strategy of using hardware as an entry point for AI agents, with pricing that signals Alibaba is competing on features rather than undercutting rivals.

stories.title: Dating app Bumble agrees to go private in a $1.3 billion deal with Ithaca Holdings
stories.reason: Shareholders will get $6.05 a share, a premium of over 100% to recent trading, as founder Whitney Wolfe Herd and Blackstone approve the all-cash buyout of a company once valued at $14 billion but now grappling with falling revenue and shrinking paid subscriptions.
